title: Tools for proving that graphs are not graceful
summary: A graph with $m$ edges is graceful if its vertices can be labeled with distinct integers in $[0,m]$ whose edge differences are exactly $1,\dots,m$. Graceful labelings have been constructed for sixty years, but there are few general methods for showing that a graph is not graceful.
